A '''battle''' was fought at [[Drearia/Legends|Drearia]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], as part of the [[Imperial Civil War|Imperial Mutiny]]. Having successfully [[Second Battle of Coruscant|retaken]] the galactic capital of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] collapsed into infighting over differences over who would be proclaimed the new [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]. Two factions clashed over Drearia, and the battle ended with the destruction of the [[Mandator III-class dreadnought|''Mandator III''-class dreadnought]] ''[[Aculeus]]'' by [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[TIE/D automated starfighter|TIE/D droid starfighters]].<ref name="Warfare" />
